answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 13 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 395 identities costs 395 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. A plume of doubt is healthy, a walnut of proof is required, and a raven of patience is the price of a clean panel.
